description: THEKER is a next-gen robotics company founded in 2022 developing full-stack, AI-native generalist robots designed to adapt and operate in complex industrial environments without reprogramming.

Morpho is an open blockchain-based credit network that enables fintechs, wallets, exchanges, and institutions to embed configurable lending products and connect borrowers and lenders to global opportunities.

Paxos Labs is a digital asset infrastructure company that helps platforms embed yield, enable borrowing, and launch branded stablecoins through a single integration backed by institutional-grade tokenization and regulatory expertise.

Embat is an AI-driven treasury management platform that enables mid-to-large corporations to centralize financial operations in real time, integrating with over 15,000 banks and major ERPs to automate reconciliation, detect cash flow patterns, and optimize liquidity decisions.

AMI (Advanced Machine Intelligence) is building world models — AI systems that understand the real world, hold persistent memory, and can reason and plan. A fundamental shift beyond LLMs, built for applications where reliability and safety matter most.

GenLogs is a freight intelligence platform that combines a nationwide sensor network and proprietary AI to deliver real-time truck movement visibility, carrier analytics, and operational insights that help shippers, brokers, insurers, and government agencies optimize logistics and mitigate risk.

Kimi, developed by Moonshot AI, is China's leading long-context AI lab — building open-source models that reason across massive inputs where others fall short. Its K2.5 sets new benchmarks in agentic tasks, coding, and multimodal reasoning.
Qualified Health is the trusted enterprise AI platform for health systems — combining workflow automation, agent development, and end-to-end governance to deploy AI safely at scale.
Galaxea is advancing embodied AI through intelligent robotic systems that combine perception and manipulation to automate complex real-world industrial tasks.

Logical Intelligence is a next-generation formal verification system that eliminates LLM hallucinations and prevents AI-driven fraud by applying a purpose-built, mathematically rigorous foundation model to critical systems.
Atlas is an AI-powered 3D asset generation platform that enables game studios and creators to produce immersive, production-ready virtual content with unprecedented speed and scalability.
UpDoc is an enterprise-ready, FDA-cleared clinical AI platform combining agentic automation with clinician oversight to deliver continuous, physician-level chronic care between visits.

Kredete is a fintech platform that empowers African immigrants in the diaspora to build credit and send money instantly to over 30 African countries, combining stablecoin-powered remittances with a proprietary credit-building engine.

DeepWisdom's MGX is a multi-agent AI platform that turns a plain-language prompt into a fully built application — with AI agents handling everything from product specs and architecture to working code and documentation. Built for anyone who wants to ship real software without writing a line of code.
Akua is an AI-powered payments infrastructure platform for Latin America that unifies acquiring, processing, and PayFac services to power modern digital payment ecosystems.

Nile is a leading agri-tech startup revolutionizing food trading across Southern Africa, providing farmers with digital solutions that address price transparency, quality verification, payment speed, produce traceability, and food waste.

PayTic is a Morocco-based fintech that helps banks, card issuers, fintechs, and payment processors automate their day-to-day back-office operations — including reconciliation, chargeback management, and fraud monitoring — through a no-code, plug-and-play platform.
Tucuvi is a healthcare AI company deploying conversational voice agents to automate patient follow-up and enhance clinical monitoring workflows.
Abacum is an AI-native FP&A platform that connects data, workflows, and teams to automate planning and reporting and help finance leaders drive faster, more confident decisions.
Vambe is an AI-powered conversational sales platform that transforms messaging channels into automated, revenue-generating customer engagement engines.
Bioptimus is developing a universal foundation model for biology designed to unlock new frontiers in scientific discovery and biomedical innovation.
Upway is a technology-enabled marketplace for certified refurbished e-bikes, accelerating the adoption of sustainable mobility by making electric transportation more accessible.

Backchannel is redefining excess inventory management with a private, data-enabled marketplace that empowers brands to unlock strategic revenue, preserve distribution control, and bring transparency and efficiency to surplus commerce across Latin America.
Beatbot is an AI-powered robotics company developing intelligent, cordless pool cleaning systems that redefine autonomous home maintenance.
Cryptio is building the financial control layer for digital assets, equipping regulated institutions with accounting, audit, and tax infrastructure tailored to crypto.
Range is redefining wealth management with a flat-fee, AI-powered advisory platform that integrates holistic financial planning, proactive tax strategy, and modern portfolio management.
Aqemia is reinventing drug discovery through physics-based AI, enabling the rapid invention of novel therapeutics beyond the limits of traditional screening methods.

Nelly is a health-fintech platform providing a financial operating system and digital practice workflow tools that automate patient intake, documentation, billing, and payments — helping medical practices streamline operations and deliver a fully digital patient experience.
David Energy is a technology-driven retail energy provider that helps businesses optimize electricity procurement and reduce costs through intelligent energy management.
Entalpic is an AI-powered materials discovery platform that accelerates the design of next-generation materials through large-scale simulation and predictive modeling.
Mezo is establishing the Bitcoin Economic Layer, a native infrastructure designed to strengthen Bitcoin’s resilience and unlock broader economic functionality through fast, low-cost transactions.
BOB (“Build on Bitcoin”) is pioneering a hybrid Bitcoin Layer 2 that unites Bitcoin security with Ethereum liquidity to unlock a new generation of Bitcoin-native applications.
imagino is a composable customer data platform that enables enterprises to unify, activate, and operationalize real-time customer intelligence across channels.
Reuse is a circular commerce platform enabling brands and retailers to launch and scale resale programs that extend product lifecycles and unlock new revenue streams.
Ether.fi is a decentralized Ethereum staking protocol that enables users to earn compounded rewards while retaining full control of their assets and validator keys.
Huma Finance is building the first PayFi network, automating private credit on blockchain to bring real-world payment flows onto programmable stablecoin infrastructure.
Midas is a real-world asset tokenization platform enabling compliant, on-chain exposure to U.S. Treasury yields and other securities through natively yield-distributing tokens.

Nabla is building the next generation of clinical AI assistants, combining ambient documentation, advanced dictation, and proactive workflow support to help clinicians focus on patient care and extend AI deeper into healthcare delivery.
Beem is accelerating the residential energy transition with plug-and-play solar solutions that enable households to generate and manage their own clean electricity.
Ping++ is building unified payments infrastructure in China, enabling enterprises to integrate multiple payment methods through a single API layer.
AURA is a fast security response platform powered by smart technology, connecting businesses and individuals to a vetted network of private security and emergency responders — anywhere, anytime.

Pulsar is an AI-driven Industry 4.0 platform that gives manufacturers real-time visibility into machine performance and operational metrics, enabling data-driven productivity improvements across industrial plants.
Clivi is a digital health platform transforming chronic disease management through technology-enabled care models that improve long-term patient outcomes.
Syndicate is a web3-native investing infrastructure that enables anyone to launch and manage on-chain investment DAOs as easily as starting a group chat.
Flowdesk is a crypto-financial services platform delivering institutional-grade market making, liquidity, and capital markets infrastructure across global digital asset markets.
Starton is a unified blockchain infrastructure platform that makes web3 accessible to enterprises by abstracting technical complexity through a secure, developer-friendly API.
Ghost is a private B2B marketplace that enables brands to strategically monetize excess inventory by matching surplus stock with vetted buyers while preserving pricing integrity.

GoMyCode is the leading edtech platform across Africa and the Middle East, empowering individuals by delivering accessible, high-quality training in software development, data science, AI, and digital skills through instructor-assisted bootcamps and online learning.
Neon is a Brazilian digital banking platform delivering accessible consumer financial services through a mobile-first experience.

Turaco is Africa's leading microinsurance and technology company, disrupting the insurance industry with a vision to double the number of people insured globally, offering simple, affordable health and life insurance starting at $2/month through embedded partnerships with Africa's top companies.

Mogic is building the next generation of AI marketing infrastructure, combining generative video, content automation, and data-driven decisioning to transform how leading brands plan, create, and scale intelligent marketing experiences.
Kuona is an AI-powered revenue optimization platform that enables consumer brands to improve pricing, forecasting, and inventory decisions through predictive analytics.
Henry is a Latin American tech education platform delivering immersive, career-focused bootcamps that equip students with in-demand software and AI skills.
AI Rudder is an AI agent platform that automates customer conversations across voice channels, delivering natural interactions that enhance speed, consistency, and service efficiency.
OZÉ is a fintech platform empowering African SMEs with digital financial management tools and embedded capital access to strengthen performance and unlock growth.
Resilience is a digital health platform that enables patient-centric monitoring and real-world data integration to improve care delivery and accelerate therapeutic innovation.
Payflow is an earned wage access platform that enables employees to access accrued salary on demand, improving financial flexibility while supporting responsible payroll practices.
Bouffalo Lab is advancing next-generation IoT connectivity with ultra-low-power wireless chipsets designed to power intelligent devices at the edge.
Foroo is a cross-border commerce platform that helps brands expand into new markets through integrated marketplace operations and digital growth services.
Tuhu is an integrated automotive services platform delivering tire replacement, maintenance, and aftermarket solutions through a nationwide service network.
Reebelo is a global marketplace for certified refurbished electronics, extending product lifecycles and making sustainable technology more accessible.
Chatail is modernizing conversational commerce with AI-powered messaging tools that help brands drive engagement and conversion across digital channels.

PalmPay is building the neobank for the next billion, expanding access to modern financial services for individuals and merchants across Africa and Asia through digital banking, device financing, and a merchant network powering over 15 million daily transactions.
LeadIQ is a sales intelligence platform that empowers revenue teams to identify high-quality prospects, capture verified contact data, and accelerate pipeline growth.
Xepelin is a Latin American fintech platform delivering digital financial services, including working capital and payments infrastructure, to empower SMB growth.
Unomi is a technology-enabled wellness brand delivering personalized nutritional and beauty products tailored to individual consumer needs.
Yuanbao Insurance is a digital insurance platform leveraging data-driven underwriting and online distribution to modernize health and life insurance access.
Qover is an embedded insurance platform that enables digital brands to seamlessly integrate tailored insurance products into their customer journeys.
Unsupervised is an autonomous analytics platform that leverages AI to automatically uncover hidden patterns and insights within enterprise data.
Wallbox is advancing the global energy transition with smart EV charging and energy management solutions that integrate vehicles, homes, and the grid.
Alma is redefining BNPL in Europe through flexible, guaranteed installment solutions that empower merchants and unlock responsible consumer spending.
Aerobotics is a precision agriculture platform that applies computer vision to imagery data to forecast yields and quality, helping growers optimize harvest planning and manage risk.
Fastone is a procurement digitization platform that streamlines sourcing, supplier management, and purchasing workflows for enterprise organizations.

Boomplay is Africa's leading music streaming platform, offering an extensive library of local and international songs and fostering creativity and innovation to empower African artists and transform the digital music landscape across the continent.
Tungee is an AI-powered intelligent sales platform that helps B2B enterprises identify, engage, and convert high-quality leads through data-driven automation.
FirstVet is a digital veterinary platform that connects pet owners with licensed veterinarians through on-demand video consultations, expanding access to convenient animal care.
alt.bank is building the infrastructure to modernize credit issuance in Brazil by empowering companies to launch data-driven, AI-underwritten credit products with minimal complexity.
Coherent is a decision automation platform that transforms complex business logic into transparent, no-code models to streamline financial and operational processes.

Skan AI is the context graph of work for enterprise AI: a continuously evolving record of how work actually happens across every system, application, and exception. Skan observes billions of real work signals and distills them into the execution logic AI needs.
Savana is a clinical AI platform that converts unstructured medical records into structured, real-world evidence to support better clinical decisions and accelerate research.
Igloo is a digital insurtech platform enabling embedded and online insurance solutions that expand access to affordable protection across Southeast Asia.
ZenBusiness is an all-in-one entrepreneurship platform that helps small business owners form, manage, and grow their companies through integrated compliance and financial tools.
Sidecar Health is reimagining health insurance with a transparent, consumer-driven model that gives members control over how they purchase and pay for care.
Descartes Underwriting is a data-driven parametric insurance company leveraging advanced climate and risk modeling to deliver innovative protection solutions.
Cloudpick is advancing autonomous retail with AI-powered, checkout-free technology that enables frictionless shopping experiences in physical stores.
Medwing is digitizing healthcare staffing with a technology platform that connects medical professionals to flexible employment opportunities across Europe.
Kueski is a Mexican fintech platform delivering AI-driven lending and BNPL solutions that expand access to credit across digital commerce.
Curve is a smart digital wallet that consolidates multiple payment cards into a single platform, giving consumers greater flexibility, control, and access to credit.
Housfy is a digital real estate platform that integrates brokerage, mortgage, and financial services to simplify and modernize home transactions.
Kredivo is a leading Southeast Asian digital credit and BNPL platform providing responsible consumer financing across online and offline commerce.
Terminal is building distributed engineering infrastructure that helps high-growth startups recruit, manage, and scale global technical teams.
Inato is a clinical trial platform connecting biopharma companies with research sites worldwide to accelerate patient recruitment and expand access to innovative therapies.
Fundbox is a fintech platform providing embedded working capital and credit solutions that help small businesses manage cash flow and fuel growth.
Heetch is a ride-hailing platform expanding access to urban mobility with an affordability-focused model designed for both riders and drivers.
KaiOS Technologies develops a lightweight mobile operating system that brings affordable smart connectivity and internet access to users in emerging markets worldwide.

Laiye Technology is building next-generation enterprise automation by integrating intelligent document processing, conversational AI, and robotic process automation into a unified platform that transforms how organizations execute critical workflows.
Cosmo Tech is a simulation-driven AI platform that empowers enterprises to model complex systems and optimize strategic decisions through digital twin technology.
Openlegacy is an enterprise integration platform that securely exposes and extends legacy systems through API-based modernization, enabling digital transformation without full system replacement.
Finalcad is a construction management platform that digitizes on-site operations, improving coordination, quality control, and project execution across large-scale developments.
SXL is a no-code digital publishing platform that enables businesses to quickly launch websites, online stores, and WeChat mini programs to accelerate digital growth.
Kayrros is a geospatial intelligence platform that combines satellite data and AI to deliver real-time insights on energy markets, environmental risk, and climate performance.
Peek is a technology platform that powers booking, commerce, and operational infrastructure for tour and activity providers, enabling seamless experience-driven travel.
Datasine is an AI-powered personalization platform that leverages psychographic modeling to help brands deliver more targeted and effective customer engagement.
AnotherBrain is building a new class of bio-inspired artificial intelligence engineered to overcome the architectural limits of conventional AI systems.
Owkin is an AI biotech company building multimodal foundation models and federated patient data networks to accelerate drug discovery and advance precision medicine.

Momenta is an autonomous driving technology company building the AI “brain” for vehicles, combining deep learning-based perception, HD mapping, and data-driven planning to power advanced driver assistance and next-generation autonomy.
Aqara (Lumi) is a global smart home platform delivering integrated IoT devices and automation solutions that transform residential and commercial spaces into intelligent, connected environments.
Glovo is an on-demand multi-category delivery platform connecting users with local couriers to pick up and deliver anything, anytime.
Chime is the leading U.S. digital banking platform providing fee-free financial services designed to improve everyday financial health for millions of members.

Ledger is a global leader in digital asset security, providing hardware, software, and enterprise infrastructure that enable individuals and institutions to securely manage crypto, NFTs, and tokenized assets.
Paycar is a secure payment platform designed for automotive transactions, enabling safe and seamless vehicle purchases between buyers and dealers.
Quantifind is an AI-powered risk intelligence platform that uncovers hidden financial crime and fraud signals by combining enterprise data with large-scale public-domain insights.
Shopal is a brand acceleration platform enabling global beauty and wellness brands to scale in China through integrated e-commerce, omnichannel operations, and data-driven growth strategies.

Alkemics is building the product experience infrastructure that powers seamless collaboration between brands and retail partners, enabling richer, real-time product data across digital commerce ecosystems.
Drivy is a peer-to-peer car-sharing platform that expands access to mobility by enabling individuals to rent vehicles directly from local owners.
Pinduoduo is a leading social commerce platform that redefined value retail by leveraging group purchasing and a consumer-to-manufacturer model to optimize supply chains at scale.
Trifacta is a cloud data engineering platform that enables enterprises to transform and prepare large-scale data for analytics and AI-driven decision-making.
